_meta.purpose: appkit.leadgen golden input: .disco/appspec.json + index.html, lead_form starter, a boolean phone-field toggle tweak, STRICT verification, cloudflare_project export. Exercises the semantic AppKit tool path (app_* tools, not raw file writes).

semantic_metadata.note: AppKit sections/fields are anchored by data-disco-* so app_* semantic edits target stable nodes. The lead_form starter provides hero/headline/lead/cta_text/viewport tokens.

attributes.source: tweak:collect_phone toggles presence of this control

tweak_metadata.note: Boolean phone-field toggle. controls_behavior=true (adds/removes a form control) satisfies the grounding law. Persisted to .disco/tweaks.json; value lives in AppSpec.tweaks and is set via app_set_tweak.

evidence_host_must_observe: both required files exist: .disco/appspec.json (parses) and index.html
preview route serves index.html with HTTP 200 and a clean browser console
STRICT level: lead form renders, submits, and produces a receipt/confirmation state (form is functional, not decorative)
collect_phone tweak toggles the tel input on/off and AppSpec.tweaks reflects the persisted value
no false affordances: every visible control is wired

known_invalid_variants.name: raw_write_to_entrypoint
known_invalid_variants.mutation: index.html mutated via raw file_write instead of an app_* semantic edit
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: governed artifact routing (CD-TOOLS) / safe_write_file refuses to clobber the artifact entrypoint; edit must go through app_update_content et al.

known_invalid_variants.name: dead_submit_button
known_invalid_variants.mutation: lead form CTA renders but submit handler is unwired (no receipt, no POST)
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: ready_for_app_verification STRICT rejects: false-affordance / non-functional form fails the strict functional-evidence gate

known_invalid_variants.name: phone_tweak_ungrounded
known_invalid_variants.mutation: collect_phone declared with controls_behavior=false and affects=[]
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: TweakSpec grounding law rejects: tweak must control behavior OR affect >=1 field
